description: Call this at the START of any task you do for a person: a page, a feature, a bug fix, a new product idea, a database change, a document. Returns which ihumane modules apply and the start tool to call next (UI design, Code craft, Product thinking, Copy), the five rules for working with a person on any task, and the rules most likely to matter for this task.

task.description: What you've been asked to do, in a sentence, e.g. 'fix the date bug in reports' or 'a pricing page for a small SaaS'
